environment.description: AWS Lambda-backed Step Functions activity worker running in VPC subnet-0a1b2c3d with NAT gateway for internet access. S3 access via regional endpoint (not VPC endpoint). IAM role arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/WorkflowWorkerRole has s3:GetObject on CONFIG_BUCKET and s3:PutObject on RESULTS_BUCKET. lodash@4.17.15 installed. Step Function input is user-controllable via StartExecution API with no input validation at the state machine level.
